revision: S2 schematic, P3 placement (THT only, SMD parked, unrouted): modules/8bit on an STM32G071C8T6 for Eurorack, 6HP
frame: Panel frame: origin at the panel upper-left corner seen from the front, X across (right), Y down, mm. KiCad sheet position = kicad_origin + panel XY. The main PCB F side faces the panel, so the KiCad top view equals the front view (no mirroring).
rail_note: Single hole pair at X12.58 (Doepfer X7.5 moved 1HP right), as modules/hats and modules/16bit. Skiff rails as the MIDI module: clear Y8.0..120.5.

main_pcb.note: 29 x 110 mm (as modules/hats / 16bit); four layers planned F / In1 GND / In2 +3V3 / B. All assembled SMD on B. 1 mm copper-edge keep-out (min_copper_edge_clearance 1.0). Held by the five jack bushings/nuts; pots are soldered only.

panel_order: MIDI + CV; P1 + P2; MODE button, its LED and P3 on one row; OUT 1 + OUT 2 at the bottom. No gate output (removed in S2).
row_note: Two columns X7.95 / X22.05: modules/hats X7.75 / X22.25 moved 0.2 mm inward so the RV09 courtyards keep the 1 mm board-edge keep-out (1.02 mm). P2 (user, 2026-11-06): jacks Y21; pot rows Y45 and Y69 (24 mm pitch, 5 mm more clearance to the MIDI/CV jacks than P1); row 3 = MODE switch X6.5 (rot 90), LED X12.85, P3 X22.05; OUT 1 / OUT 2 as low as the 1 mm keep-out allows (Y110.4, courtyard 1.01 mm above the bottom edge); power header upright on B at the right edge between P3 and OUT 2. P3 (user, 2026-11-06): row 3 moved 3 mm further from P1/P2 (pitch 27 mm) and the pot block centred between the jack rows on the panel: jack centres Y21 / Y110.4 (mid Y65.7), pot rows Y52.2 / Y79.2 (mid Y65.7), 31.2 mm from either jack row. Courtyard gaps: MIDI/CV to P1/P2 18.2 mm, P1/P2 to row 3 13.2 mm, row 3 (RV3) to OUT 1/2 16.2 mm. J6 SWD moved to Y93 to clear the MODE switch legs.
pot_part: Song Huei R0904N 50k linear (user stock), vertical snap-in, tall shaft (L = 25 mm, knurled, no threaded bushing, no nut): the pot Bread Modular uses, on the Bread Modular Potentiometer_RV09 footprint

pots.role: P3 (50k, PA7; was the 8bit passive low-pass), right of MODE/LED

buttons.note: modules/8bit SW1: generic 6 x 6 x 7 mm THT tact on the carrier F side, placed by the pad-pattern centre = stem centre. rot 90 (square body, symmetric; the 8bit round printed cap fits unchanged) so the courtyard is 7.6 mm wide and MODE, LED and P3 fit on one row; legs X4.25 / X8.75, Y75.95 / Y82.45. Same Z stack as 8bit/16bit.

leds.note: 3 mm red THT on F (as 8bit D1), rot 90: pads along Y centred on XY, between the MODE switch and P3 on their row; dome flush with the panel front.

stack_Z_mm.datum: Z0 = carrier F.Cu, +Z toward the panel
stack_Z_mm.note: As modules/8bit and modules/16bit (PJ301M-12 boss top = panel rear; 3 mm LED dome flush with the 1.6 mm FR4 front; the switch stem top is 3.0 mm below the panel rear, bridged by the 8bit printed cap).

power_header.orientation: Upright at the right edge (user P2: off the bottom edge, to the right), rot 180 on B: odd pins on the inner column X23.8, even pins on X26.34; pins 1/2 (-12 V) at the bottom Y99.5, pins 9/10 (+12 V) at the top Y89.34. Courtyard X21.99..28.15 (1.35 mm from the right edge).
power_header.idc_note: A 16-pin cable plugs on aligned at pin 1 (red stripe = -12 V, at the bottom); positions 11-16 overhang upward over the board, never past an edge. Envelope = 2x8 socket (25.4 x 6.4 mm body, 3.81 mm beyond the end pin centres) plus a 1.2 mm key bump on either side. P3: the centred pot block puts the RV3 lugs (Y79.2, X26.85) and pins 2/3 (Y86.7) under the overhang (a 10-pin socket, Y85.53..103.31, still covers RV3 pins 2/3). The socket underside sits 2.5 mm above B on the header plastic, so the THT leads under it must be trimmed to <= 2 mm. No pad under it otherwise (OUT 2 pads start at Y104.18). B-side SMD placed under it later must stay <= 2 mm tall.

back_side_tht.note: right edge, upright, rot 180 on B: pins 1/2 (-12 V) at the bottom

SWD (1 +3V3 sense, 2 SWDIO, 3 SWCLK, 4 GND, 5 NRST), vertical at the left edge between the MODE row and OUT 1, pins Y87.92..98.08 (centred on Y93, P3: 3 mm down to clear the MODE switch legs), hand-soldered on B

smd_parking.note: Every SMD part waits here, off the board edge, in reference order; it moves onto the board with its functional group (root AGENTS.md divide and conquer). No routing in S1/P1.
